title: Creating a new sample
summary: Generative AI creates an output using patterns learned during training. It can produce a new sentence or picture, but the result still needs checking.
introduction: Generative AI creates an output using patterns learned during training. It can produce a new sentence or picture, but the result still needs checking. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Generative AI creates an output using patterns learned during training. It can produce a new sentence or picture, but the result still needs checking.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.text: These lessons mostly use written plans. They do not call an AI service or generate real AI media. The few Python examples need a separate Python 3 environment. No account or secret key is needed.
This course teaches the basics. It does not cover every feature of Generative AI. Keep real personal data and secret keys out of practice files.

blocks.code:
Request: write a two-line story about a kite
Possible output: A red kite rose above the field. Its string tugged gently in Mira's hand.
Check: two sentences, a kite, and a clear setting
blocks.title: Creating a new sample

blocks.text: This is a written example of a possible output. It shows what we would check; the website has not called a text model.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a second possible story that follows the same request.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Newly generated text is not automatically true, original in every phrase, or suitable for every use.
For more detail later, use this [Generative AI further reading](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/intro-to-ml/what-is-ml).
